authorization.name: link_authorizations
authorization.sql: CREATE TABLE link_authorizations(ref TEXT PRIMARY KEY,digest TEXT NOT NULL,account_ref TEXT NOT NULL,network_id TEXT NOT NULL,request_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,native_id TEXT)

authorization.name: link_native_once
authorization.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX link_native_once ON link_authorizations(native_id) WHERE native_id IS NOT NULL

authorization.name: link_issuance_tombstone
authorization.sql: CREATE TRIGGER link_issuance_tombstone BEFORE DELETE ON link_authorizations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'link_issuance_permanent'); END

authorization.name: link_issuance_immutable
authorization.sql: CREATE TRIGGER link_issuance_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON link_authorizations WHEN NEW.ref != OLD.ref OR NEW.digest != OLD.digest OR NEW.account_ref != OLD.account_ref OR NEW.network_id != OLD.network_id OR NEW.request_key != OLD.request_key OR (OLD.native_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.native_id IS NOT OLD.native_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'link_issuance_immutable'); END

submission.name: link_mpp_prepared
submission.sql: CREATE TABLE link_mpp_prepared(ref TEXT PRIMARY KEY,snapshot_digest TEXT NOT NULL,challenge_digest TEXT NOT NULL,challenge_json TEXT NOT NULL)

submission.name: link_mpp_dispatches
submission.sql: CREATE TABLE link_mpp_dispatches(ref TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES link_mpp_prepared(ref),claim_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

submission.name: link_mpp_prepared_no_update
submission.sql: CREATE TRIGGER link_mpp_prepared_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON link_mpp_prepared BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'link_mpp_immutable'); END

submission.name: link_mpp_prepared_no_delete
submission.sql: CREATE TRIGGER link_mpp_prepared_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON link_mpp_prepared BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'link_mpp_permanent'); END

submission.name: link_mpp_dispatches_no_update
submission.sql: CREATE TRIGGER link_mpp_dispatches_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON link_mpp_dispatches BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'link_mpp_immutable'); END

submission.name: link_mpp_dispatches_no_delete
submission.sql: CREATE TRIGGER link_mpp_dispatches_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON link_mpp_dispatches BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'link_mpp_permanent'); END

provider.name: link_provider_prepared
provider.sql: CREATE TABLE link_provider_prepared(ref TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scope TEXT NOT NULL,execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,installation_digest TEXT NOT NULL,intent_digest TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(scope,execution_id))

provider.name: link_provider_prepared_immutable
provider.sql: CREATE TRIGGER link_provider_prepared_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON link_provider_prepared BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'link_provider_preparation_immutable'); END

provider.name: link_provider_prepared_permanent
provider.sql: CREATE TRIGGER link_provider_prepared_permanent BEFORE DELETE ON link_provider_prepared BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'link_provider_preparation_permanent'); END
